description: One group from list_accommodations (group_id): type, room_types, meal/board options, distance, amenities, age and min-stay rules, and week prices for startDate and currency. Use after list_accommodations, before save_trip or calculate_trip_price, or to answer questions about one option. Week prices are indicative; call calculate_trip_price for a checkout total.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this call. Usually EUR.

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

startDate.description: Course start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically a Monday from list_starting_dates.

name: get_accommodation_details

group.description: Accommodation group from GET /v3/accommodations/{id} (v2 grouping): labels, classification, room and meal options, facilities, rules, and pricing hints for the requested start date.

classification.description: Accommodation type, class, and room metadata.

distance.description: Distance-to-school summary (string or structured object from the API).

group_name.description: Grouped title when room-type grouping is enabled.

meal_options.description: Board/meal plans with pricing_for_requested_weeks when not split by room_types.

name.description: Display name of the accommodation group.

room_types.description: Room variants, each with meal_options, stay_length, and week pricing.

stay_length.description: Minimum and maximum stay in weeks.
